title: Flux 软萌动漫风：日系插画 prompt
description: Flux 跑日系软萌动漫的 prompt 写法 + 跨模型对比。

prompt.main: soft anime illustration of a young girl with white cat ears and golden eyes, wearing a pastel pink hoodie, sitting on a windowsill at sunset, holding a small cup of tea, soft pink and orange color palette, gentle wind blowing her hair, detailed anime eyes, watercolor texture, makoto shinkai inspired lighting

explained.why: Flux 软萌风比 SD 稳，色彩更通透
Flux 没 negative prompt，正向写全

tutorial.intro: Flux 跑日系软萌风有独特优势：色彩通透 + 头发/眼睛细节好。
steps: 【角色】young girl with white cat ears and golden eyes — 萌系必备：兽耳 + 异色瞳
【服装】pastel pink hoodie — 萌系配色 + 服装
【场景】sitting on a windowsill at sunset, holding a small cup of tea — 治愈系场景
【光线】gentle wind blowing her hair — 动态（风）+ 光线
【配色】soft pink and orange color palette — 限定配色范围
【风格锚定】makoto shinkai inspired lighting — 锚定新海诚光线
tutorial.tips: Flux 跑动漫比 SD 慢但质量高。如果你需要快速出图，SD + AnythingV5 仍然是性价比首选。

crossModel.midjourney: MJ Niji 6: "soft anime illustration of a cat ear girl with golden eyes, pastel pink hoodie, windowsill, sunset --niji 6 --ar 3:4"
crossModel.jimeng_zh: 日系软萌动漫少女，白色猫耳，金色眼睛，粉色卫衣，窗台，日落，茶杯，新海诚光线

faq.q: Flux 跑动漫和 SD 比？
faq.a: Flux 色彩更好但慢。SD 生态强 (LoRA) 但需要调参

faq.q: 为什么软萌风总是"塑料感"？
faq.a: 缺质感词。加 "watercolor texture" 或 "soft airbrush" 立刻有手绘感
